from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document for classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(..., description="The title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书1》'")
    document_type: str | None = Field(None, description="Type of the document, e.g., '民事判决书', '行政裁定书', '刑事判决书'")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(None, description="The broad legal nature of the case, e.g., '行政', '民事', '刑事'")
    core_dispute: str | None = Field(None, description="The core legal dispute or subject matter, e.g., '房屋征收', '专利侵权', '盗窃罪', '执行异议'")
    administrative_party: str | None = Field(None, description="Name of the administrative body involved, if any")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentInfo]
